summary: Full e2e test of MoboExpress delivery + accounting integration. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/me/register/duplicate), riders listing & auth-required, currency assignment (MAD for Tanger/Morocco, EUR for Algeciras/Spain), distance_km haversine, RBAC (rider 403 on POST /api/assignments, rider GET /api/orders filtered to own), COD_cash->delivered auto-creates 'entrada' in cash closing (correct method=efectivo, currency, order_id, amount, paid=true, cash_movement_id set), card delivered does NOT create entry, EUR COD cash flow creates EUR entry. Frontend: Login admin->/ works, WS badge 'Tiempo real activo' shown, order creation form (Tanger/Morocco/COD/333.33) works, rider assignment via select works, advance-button drives status through assigned->picked_up->in_transit->delivered, navigation to /contabilidad shows the auto-generated COD entry in movements (table contains 'Pedido ORD-xxxx (COD efectivo)').

minor.issue: Backend correctly lowercases email; tests must use lowercase prefix (already fixed in test). Not a bug — informational.

integration_issues.issue: Transient warning 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' appears once on first navigation right after login; badge subsequently shows 'Tiempo real activo' so reconnect succeeds. Not blocking but worth a small reconnect-on-mount delay or single retry.

issues: Default currency tab is 'EUR' on /contabilidad even when most operations are MAD-region; consider defaulting to MAD or remembering last currency.

action_items: OPTIONAL: smooth out the first-load WebSocket reconnect to avoid the transient console warning.
OPTIONAL: default Contabilidad currency tab based on the most-used currency for the day instead of EUR.

OPTIONAL: test data is accumulating in the riders dropdown (multiple 'Test Rider' entries from /api/auth/register tests). Consider a cleanup endpoint or filter inactive=true for production data hygiene.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 549 lines; getting heavy. Consider extracting accounting/* router into /app/backend/accounting.py to mirror the modular pattern already used for auth/orders/assignments/riders.

orders.py update_status: COD->cash entry creation is idempotent against re-delivery only because of the 'paid' guard inside _create_cod_cash_entry. Good. However, if status is set to 'delivered' twice and the order had paid=False initially (e.g., status was set to delivered manually without going through the helper before), a second call would not duplicate because paid is now True — verified.
auth.py _set_cookies uses secure=False; acceptable in dev/preview but should be driven by env (e.g., SECURE_COOKIES=true) before production.
No rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented — acceptable for MVP but a known gap.
geo.py defaults non-Moroccan-non-EU countries to EUR; document this assumption or restrict to a known list.
MongoDB ObjectId is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (login, order create, assign, advance to delivered, COD->cash visible in /contabilidad, WS realtime badge)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* prefixed orders and several test_rider_* users via /api/auth/register. No teardown implemented (data accumulates in test_database). Add a cleanup fixture for next iteration if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_moboexpress_api.py covers all critical paths. Run: cd /app && pytest backend/tests/test_moboexpress_api.py -v. Frontend Playwright sequence: login -> fill order form (Tanger/Morocco/cod_cash) -> select rider from assign-select-<code> -> click advance-<code> 3x -> verify /contabilidad shows 'Pedido ORD-...' in movements table. Backend uses Bearer token in Authorization header (also sets httpOnly cookies). WS at wss://<host>/api/ws?token=<access_token>. DB_NAME=test_database. Google Maps key intentionally empty (LiveMap shows dev fallback, not a bug).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The single test failure on first run was a test-side issue (uppercase TEST_ prefix vs backend lowercasing email). Fixed in test; all 15 backend tests now pass and frontend e2e is fully green.
